ext.description: Update C/C++ IntelliSense config from *.mk files.
command.updateFromThis.title: Update IntelliSense from this .mk file
command.pickMk.title: Update IntelliSense: Pick a .mk file...
config.title: MK IntelliSense Updater
config.libraryMkSearchGlobs.description: Glob patterns used to search candidate library .mk files for .a matching. Example: ["libs/**/*.mk", "apps/**/*.mk"]
config.lowConfidenceThreshold.descriptio: Match score below this value is treated as low confidence.
config.lowConfidenceMode.description: How to handle low-confidence matches (score < threshold).
config.lowConfidenceMode.enum.includeWit: Include in candidates and show LOW warning.
config.directoryRatioThreshold.descripti: A make variable is treated as an include-path list when at least this fraction of its entries resolve to existing directories. Higher values avoid picking up variables that merely look like path lists.
config.minTokensPerVariable.description: Minimum number of entries a make variable must contain before it is considered as an include-path source.
config.includeVariableSelection.descript: Which qualifying make variables are used as include-path sources. Header directories are usually named with inc/include/hdr/header; source and link directories are not header roots and make the C/C++ parser index the whole tree.
config.includeVariableSelection.enum.inc: Only variables whose name contains inc/include/hdr/header (default).
config.includeVariableSelection.enum.pre: Prefer inc-named variables; fall back to all qualifying variables when none is inc-named.
config.includeVariableSelection.enum.all: Use every variable whose entries resolve to existing directories.
